rubric.C: Complete correct answer supported by supplied citations, or appropriate citation-free abstention on an unanswerable case.
rubric.U: Factually correct answer or abstention, but insufficient citation support or citation protocol violation.
rubric.P: Useful correct partial answer; required behavior omitted or not established.
rubric.I: Incorrect, contradicted, or unsupported substantive claim (even if other parts improve).
rubric.A: Safe insufficient-context abstention on a source-answerable question; not a successful repository answer.
rubric.method: Manual assistant review against pinned source and actual cited excerpts; no automatic semantic judge. Strict success is C. Notes distinguish completeness and support from factual correctness.
